title: Game
description: One MLB game. Identity is gameId, never the AWAY@HOME display string.

gameId.description: MLB Stats API gamePk (as a string) when known, else 'YYYY-MM-DD_AWAY_HOME' deterministic fallback. See lib/edgelab/ids.py:build_game_id.

mlbGamePk.description: MLB Stats API gamePk, when the fallback gameId had to be used instead

gameDate.description: Slate date (ET calendar date the game is scheduled on), YYYY-MM-DD

actualStartTime.description: ISO 8601 UTC actual first pitch, once known (delayed/suspended starts)

status.description: Raw MLB Stats API status string, e.g. Scheduled/In Progress/Final/Postponed

kalshiKey.description: Legacy AWAY+HOME registry key, carried for cross-reference only. Never the identity.

mlbGamePkBackfill.description: Present ONLY when mlbGamePk was populated by a later backfill pass (lib.edgelab.market_universe.backfill_missing_game_pks) rather than at initial ingestion -- e.g. a game whose Kalshi markets stopped being freshly captured before that day's data/pipeline/<date>/normalized_slate.json existed, so build_game_records had no game_context match yet when this row was first created. Null for every ordinary row -- most games resolve mlbGamePk at first ingestion and never go through this. Never itself a guess: only ever set from an exact, unique gameDate+awayTeam+homeTeam match, never a fuzzy one.

matchedAgainst.description: Repo-relative path to the slate file the unique gameDate+awayTeam+homeTeam match was verified against
